SPOON_SPIRE_SOUVENIR.description: You can now find cards from the other Slay the Spire.
SPOON_SPIRE_SOUVENIR.flavor: A little piece of an older Spire.
SPOON_SPIRE_SOUVENIR.title: Spire Souvenir
STS1_BLOODY_IDOL.flavor: The idol now weeps a constant stream of blood.
STS1_BLOODY_IDOL.title: Bloody Idol
STS1_BUSTED_CROWN.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Future [gold]card rewards[/gold] have [blue]{Cards}[/blue] fewer cards to choose from.
STS1_BUSTED_CROWN.flavor: The Champ's crown... or a pale imitation?
STS1_BUSTED_CROWN.title: Busted Crown
STS1_CHAMPION_BELT.flavor: Only the greatest may wear this belt.
STS1_CHAMPION_BELT.title: Champion Belt
STS1_COFFEE_DRIPPER.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. You can no longer Rest at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
STS1_COFFEE_DRIPPER.flavor: "Yes, another cup please. Back to work. Back to work!" - The Architect
STS1_COFFEE_DRIPPER.title: Coffee Dripper
STS1_CURSED_KEY.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Whenever you open a chest, obtain a [gold]Curse[/gold].
STS1_CURSED_KEY.flavor: You can feel the malicious energy emanating from the key. Power comes at a price.
STS1_CURSED_KEY.title: Cursed Key
STS1_DAMARU.description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Mantra[/gold].
STS1_DAMARU.flavor: The sound of the small drum keeps your mind awake, revealing a path forward.
STS1_DAMARU.title: Damaru
STS1_DUALITY.description: Whenever you play an [gold]Attack[/gold], gain [blue]1[/blue] temporary [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
STS1_DUALITY.flavor: "And the sun was extinguished forever, as if curtains fell before it." - Zoroth
STS1_DUALITY.title: Duality
STS1_ENCHIRIDION.description: At the start of each combat, add a random Power into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs [blue]0[/blue] that turn.
STS1_ENCHIRIDION.flavor: The legendary journal of an ancient lich.
STS1_ENCHIRIDION.title: Enchiridion
STS1_FROZEN_CORE.description: Replaces [gold]Cracked Core[/gold]. If you end your turn with any empty Orb slots, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Frost[/gold].
STS1_FROZEN_CORE.flavor: The crack in your core has been filled with a pulsating cold energy.
STS1_FROZEN_CORE.title: Frozen Core
STS1_FUSION_HAMMER.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. You can no longer Smith at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
STS1_FUSION_HAMMER.flavor: Once wielded, the owner can never let go.
STS1_FUSION_HAMMER.title: Fusion Hammer
STS1_GOLDEN_EYE.description: Whenever you [gold]Scry[/gold], look at [blue]2[/blue] additional cards.
STS1_GOLDEN_EYE.flavor: See into the minds of those nearby, predicting their future moves.
STS1_GOLDEN_EYE.title: Golden Eye
STS1_GOLDEN_IDOL.flavor: Made of solid gold, you feel richer just holding it.
STS1_GOLDEN_IDOL.title: Golden Idol
STS1_HOLY_WATER.description: Replaces [gold]Pure Water[/gold]. At the start of combat, add {Cards} [gold]Miracles[/gold] to your hand.
STS1_HOLY_WATER.flavor: Collected from a time before the Spire.
STS1_HOLY_WATER.title: Holy Water
STS1_HOVERING_KITE.description: The first time you discard a card each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
STS1_HOVERING_KITE.flavor: The Kite floats around you in battle, propelled by a mysterious force.
STS1_HOVERING_KITE.title: Hovering Kite
STS1_INSERTER.title: Inserter
STS1_MAGIC_FLOWER.description: Healing is [blue]50%[/blue] more effective during combat.
STS1_MAGIC_FLOWER.flavor: A flower long thought extinct, somehow preserved in perfect condition.
STS1_MAGIC_FLOWER.title: Magic Flower
STS1_MARK_OF_PAIN.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. At the start of each combat, shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Wounds[/gold] into your draw pile.
STS1_MARK_OF_PAIN.flavor: This brand was used by the northern tribes to signify warriors who had mastered pain in battle.
STS1_MARK_OF_PAIN.title: Mark of Pain
STS1_MARK_OF_THE_BLOOM.flavor: In the Beyond, thoughts and reality are one.
STS1_MARK_OF_THE_BLOOM.title: Mark of the Bloom
STS1_MELANGE.description: Whenever you shuffle your draw pile, [gold]Scry[/gold] [blue]3[/blue].
STS1_MELANGE.flavor: Mysterious sands from an unknown origin. Smells of cinnamon.
STS1_MELANGE.title: Melange
STS1_MUTAGENIC_STRENGTH.description: Start each combat with [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. At the end of your first turn, lose [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
STS1_MUTAGENIC_STRENGTH.flavor: "The results seem fleeting, triggering when the subject is in danger." - Unknown
STS1_MUTAGENIC_STRENGTH.title: Mutagenic Strength
STS1_NECRONOMICON.description: The first [gold]Attack[/gold] played each turn that costs [blue]{Cost}[/blue] or more is played twice. Upon pickup, add a [red]Necronomicurse[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
STS1_NECRONOMICON.flavor: Only a fool would try and harness this evil power. At night your dreams are haunted by images of the book devouring your mind.
STS1_NECRONOMICON.title: Necronomicon
STS1_NILRYS_CODEX.description: At the end of your turn, you may shuffle [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random cards into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
STS1_NILRYS_CODEX.flavor: Crafted by the infamous game master himself. Said to expand one's mind.
STS1_NILRYS_CODEX.title: Nilry's Codex
STS1_NUCLEAR_BATTERY.description: At the start of each combat, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Plasma[/gold].
STS1_NUCLEAR_BATTERY.title: Nuclear Battery
STS1_PURE_WATER.description: At the start of combat, add {Cards} [gold]Miracle[/gold] to your hand.
STS1_PURE_WATER.flavor: Filtered through fine sand and free of impurities.
STS1_PURE_WATER.title: Pure Water
STS1_RING_OF_THE_SERPENT.description: Replaces [gold]Ring of the Snake[/gold]. At the start of each turn, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
STS1_RING_OF_THE_SERPENT.flavor: Your ring has morphed and changed forms.
STS1_RING_OF_THE_SERPENT.title: Ring of the Serpent
STS1_RUNIC_CUBE.description: Whenever you lose HP, draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
STS1_RUNIC_CUBE.title: Runic Cube
STS1_RUNIC_DOME.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. You can no longer see enemy intents.
STS1_RUNIC_DOME.title: Runic Dome
STS1_SACRED_BARK.flavor: A bark rumored to originate from the World tree.
STS1_SACRED_BARK.title: Sacred Bark
STS1_SLAVERS_COLLAR.description: During Boss and Elite combats, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.
STS1_SLAVERS_COLLAR.title: Slaver's Collar
STS1_SPIRIT_POOP.flavor: The charred remains of your offering to the spirits.
STS1_SPIRIT_POOP.title: Spirit Poop
STS1_TEARDROP_LOCKET.flavor: Its owner blind, its contents unseen.
STS1_TEARDROP_LOCKET.title: Teardrop Locket
STS1_THE_SPECIMEN.description: Whenever an enemy dies, transfer any [gold]Poison[/gold] it has to a random enemy.
STS1_THE_SPECIMEN.flavor: "Fascinating! I found a mutated creature demonstrating astounding toxic properties. Storing a sample for later examination." - Ranwid
STS1_THE_SPECIMEN.title: The Specimen
STS1_TINY_HOUSE.description: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]1[/blue] potion, gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue], obtain [blue]1[/blue] card and upgrade [blue]1[/blue] random card.
STS1_TINY_HOUSE.flavor: "A near perfect implementation of miniaturization. My finest work to date, but still not adequate." - The Architect
STS1_TINY_HOUSE.title: Tiny House
STS1_VIOLET_LOTUS.description: Whenever you leave [gold]Calm[/gold], gain [blue]1[/blue] additional Energy.
STS1_VIOLET_LOTUS.flavor: The old texts describe that the surface of "mana pools" were littered with these flowers.
STS1_VIOLET_LOTUS.title: Violet Lotus
STS1_WARPED_TONGS.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a random card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] for the rest of combat.
STS1_WARPED_TONGS.flavor: The cursed tongs emit a strong desire to return to where they were stolen from.
STS1_WARPED_TONGS.title: Warped Tongs
STS1_WRIST_BLADE.description: Attacks that cost [blue]0[/blue] deal [blue]4[/blue] additional damage.
STS1_WRIST_BLADE.title: Wrist Blade
